items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vietnam_account_count FROM dim_accounts WHERE country ILIKE '%vietnam%' OR country ILIKE 'vn' OR country ILIKE 'vnm'

SELECT account_id, company_name, lifetime_billed_eur
FROM dim_accounts
ORDER BY lifetime_billed_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND a.created_at < DATE '2027-01-01' THEN m.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mrr_from_2026_accounts_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(m.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr_sept2026_eur,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(m.mrr), 0) = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND a.created_at < DATE '2027-01-01' THEN m.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) / SUM(m.mrr)
  END AS pct_from_2026
FROM mrr_monthly m
LEFT JOIN dim_accounts a USING (account_id)
WHERE m.month_start = DATE '2026-09-01';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rd.amount_eur), 0) AS total_paid_eur
FROM fct_revenue_daily rd
JOIN dim_accounts a ON rd.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.country = 'Peru'
  AND rd.revenue_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

WITH months(month_start) AS (
  VALUES (DATE '2026-04-01'), (DATE '2026-05-01'), (DATE '2026-06-01')
)
SELECT
  months.month_start,
  COALESCE(cnt.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count
FROM months
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', issued_at) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM fct_invoices
  WHERE issued_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND issued_at < DATE '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
) AS cnt USING (month_start)
ORDER BY months.month_start;

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(amount_eur) AS invoiced_eur FROM fct_invoices WHERE (status IS NULL OR status <> 'void') AND issued_at::date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT month_start, churned_subscriptions
FROM (
  SELECT DATE '2026-07-01' AS month_start,
    COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(prev.active_subscriptions,0) - COALESCE(curr.active_subscriptions,0))), 0) AS churned_subscriptions
  FROM (SELECT account_id, active_subscriptions FROM mrr_monthly WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-06-01') prev
  FULL JOIN (SELECT account_id, active_subscriptions FROM mrr_monthly WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-07-01') curr USING (account_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE '2026-08-01' AS month_start,
    COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(prev.active_subscriptions,0) - COALESCE(curr.active_subscriptions,0))), 0) AS churned_subscriptions
  FROM (SELECT account_id, active_subscriptions FROM mrr_monthly WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-07-01') prev
  FULL JOIN (SELECT account_id, active_subscriptions FROM mrr_monthly WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-08-01') curr USING (account_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE '2026-09-01' AS month_start,
    COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(prev.active_subscriptions,0) - COALESCE(curr.active_subscriptions,0))), 0) AS churned_subscriptions
  FROM (SELECT account_id, active_subscriptions FROM mrr_monthly WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-08-01') prev
  FULL JOIN (SELECT account_id, active_subscriptions FROM mrr_monthly WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-09-01') curr USING (account_id)
) t
ORDER BY month_start;

SELECT
  d.account_id,
  d.company_name,
  d.country,
  d.lifetime_paid_eur,
  d.lifetime_billed_eur,
  d.open_balance_eur,
  COALESCE(m.mrr, 0) AS current_mrr_eur,
  m.active_subscriptions AS active_subscriptions_this_month,
  l.last_payment_at,
  COALESCE(r.paid_last_12m, 0) AS paid_last_12m_eur
FROM dim_accounts d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, mrr, active_subscriptions
  FROM mrr_monthly
  WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-10-01'
) m USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, MAX(last_paid_at) AS last_payment_at
  FROM fct_invoices
  GROUP BY account_id
) l USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(amount_eur) AS paid_last_12m
  FROM fct_revenue_daily
  WHERE revenue_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-22' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  GROUP BY account_id
) r USING (account_id)
ORDER BY d.lifetime_paid_eur DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT account_id, company_name, contact_name, open_balance_eur
FROM dim_accounts
ORDER BY open_balance_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_with_named_contact FROM dim_accounts WHERE lower(country) = 'peru' AND contact_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(contact_name) <> '' ;

SELECT account_id, company_name, contact_name, contact_email, lifetime_billed_eur
FROM dim_accounts
ORDER BY lifetime_billed_eur DESC
LIMIT 1;
